properties.description: reflow2_init, on update, converts a consumer's docs/design/<project>.json into the item layout in one commit-ready change, carrying item lineage from the old file's content. For one release the server, import and the gate accept either layout; the old reader is removed a release later. flo2 and every installed project migrate this way; nothing breaks on the day of the upgrade. Designed 2026-09-23.
properties.name: A project using reflow2 moves to the item layout on update, with one release of overlap
